model_annotation: The plot illustrates the accuracy (ACC) as a function of co-occurrence number. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10^3. Tick labels are present at 0, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 60 to 85. Tick labels are present at 60, 65, 70, 75, 80, and 85. A black solid line, labeled "Base," starts at approximately 63% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increases to approximately 72% at a co-occurrence number of 10^3. A blue solid line, labeled "FT," starts at approximately 66% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increases to approximately 76% at a co-occurrence number of 10^3. A red triangle marker line, labeled "IKE," starts at approximately 68% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increases to approximately 74% at a co-occurrence number of 10^3. A magenta square marker line, labeled "MEMIT," starts at approximately 69% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increases to approximately 77% at a co-occurrence number of 10^3. A green square marker line, labeled "ROME," starts at approximately 74% at the co-occurrence number of 0 and increases to approximately 82% at a co-occurrence number of 10^3.
